title: 第29章 赵小义被打了
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: 刘烨的腿脚很快，张家才吃完早饭，他就已经把所有的楠竹都备好了。也不用人交代，自己就开始用柴刀破竹。小的直接用。中的劈两半。大一点的，劈四瓣。他先沿着院边，每隔三五米种一根大柱，然后就开始插竹，边插边围。徐喜弟拉着巴儿姐出来帮忙，范金花自顾菜地里补种。张国海坐在门口，看了几眼就转身进屋，没一会儿又出来。总之什么都不做，光盯着他们干活。“这竹子割手，你们帮我扶着就行，别乱动。”刘烨也不让徐喜弟动手。本来可以不用扶的，但是有人帮忙扶一把，活能干得更快。就这样，徐喜弟和巴儿姐在院内，刘烨在院外，三人对着，一点一点围起了新的篱笆院。别家的篱笆院，都是指头大小的小树枝，只有张家，是鲜绿的楠竹。也没人说话，巴儿姐不会说。“永福怎么了，我总听见他在屋里叫唤。”刘烨终于打破了沉默。“夜里睡觉掉床了，一直喊。也不知道真疼还是假疼。”徐喜弟也分不清，张永福到底是在撒气求关心，还是真疼。老两口不吱声，她也不好说什么。她没钱，也不能一个人背着他走半天路去镇上。“会不会真摔到哪里了？”刘烨手边的活没停，如果张永福真受了伤，那还真的有人帮忙送去镇上看看才行。“明天我背去看看？”徐喜弟看了一眼范金花。范金花像没听见一般，头都没有抬，也不做声。没一会儿，她抱着一把菜出去了。“刘烨，我先上你家，帮你把中午饭做了。”……活干到中午，院子才修了一小段。徐喜弟正要进屋煮午饭，大队长带着两个人，匆匆赶过来。“张国海，你出来一下。”“刘烨，你也先别走。”也不知道什么事，徐喜弟和巴儿姐，张国海还有刘烨，被聚到张家院门外。“张国海，我问你，昨晚上你让刘烨上赵家了？”大队长也不绕什么万字，直接问道，“因为他砍了你家篱笆院和菜地，你就蓄意报复？”张国海一听，眼睛瞪得老大，“我……”他转头看向刘烨，“你昨晚去找赵小义了？”刘烨摇摇头，十分无辜，“我没去啊！我跟他又没有仇，我找他干什么？”“大队长，赵小义怎么了？他还欠我家八十块没给！”张国海现在心里只惦记赔偿款的事。那孙子要是出了什么事，钱不是打水漂了？“他睡觉，半夜让人打断腿了。还揍了个鼻青脸肿的，他说看到对方身形高大，咬定就是刘烨你！”大队长指着刘烨的鼻子，语气肯定。“你们别想赖，人打了不说，他说枕头下的五十块钱也被拿了，这是犯罪！懂不懂？”“公安来了，绝对要判个入室抢劫，要吃牢饭的！”“趁现在还没闹大，钱还回去，我就当没这是。打架算私怨，他砍了你家院子有错在先，这事咱们能私下解决，就不报公安了。”“队长，他砍张家的院子，和我有什么关系？”刘烨不慌不忙，“有人看见我上他家了吗？”“你小子别不认，昨天我要不来，你当场就要打人了。”大队长拧着眉头，脸色阴沉。要是有人看见，他就直接去报公安了，还用过来探口风？张国海一听，人被打腿断了，钱还没了，那八十块指定就没了。“大队长，我可没让刘烨上打人啊！他要是打了，跟我一点关系都没有！”“但是，不管赵小义怎么样，他该赔我家的八十块，可一分不能少，你昨天当着大伙的面同意的。他要是赖着不给，我得上你家要去！”徐喜弟还没说话，心里却暗喜。打得好。不然他隔三差五来家里砍院子，这日子还怎么过。也不知怎么的，她觉得，就是刘烨干的。肯定是替她给张家出气了。但她不能说，于是把另外一家人也牵扯进来。“大队长，有没有可能，是李婶家？毕竟李婶跟赵丁的事，闹得他们家都快抬不起头了。”“赵丁被抓了，这口气没撒，赵小义又混蛋……”“我们家就我爹这样的，可打不过赵小意。李婶家就不同了，有三个壮丁。”“烨叔他是有力气，可他憨憨的，从没对谁动过手。他一天只管给人干活换口饭吃，无缘无故去打赵小义做什么？”嗯嗯嗯~刘烨在一边，拼命点头。被这个小丫头仗义执言护着的感觉，还怪美的。“队长，怎么弄？”大队长身后的两个村民，已经相信了。主要张家人实在太弱，不成气候。刘烨也只是个傻饭桶，打人他是绝对不会干的。“先去祝英家看看。”大队长只能这样。如果李祝英也否认，那就只能报公安来查。大队长来也匆匆，去也匆匆。人一走，张国海的脸就拉下来老长，“你俩商量的主意？把赵小义打伤了，赔偿修院子的钱，还能给我们吗？”徐喜弟否认，“他和他爹是该打，但这次他们挨打纯属活该，跟我们可没关系。我也不会找烨叔干这样的事。”“我跟赵家无冤无仇，我犯不上。”刘烨耸了耸肩，也是事不关己的样子。“难道真是李家？”张国海也信了。他背着手进屋。徐喜弟和刘烨默契地对视了一眼。他憨憨地笑了。她心里更加确定，人就是他打的。他知道赵小义不会掏那八十块，所以干脆上门打一顿解气。至于那五十块……“叔，你说，打赵小义的人，要是拿了那五十块钱，不会傻傻地放在家里，等大队长去搜吧？”她暗搓搓说道。刘烨一愣，“我先回家吃中午饭了，吃过了再来，今天院子应该能修完的。”说完，他就匆匆回家去了。……大队长来到李祝英家，进门就看到鼻青脸肿的李婶，坐在堂屋里剁猪菜。有人进门也不打招呼。他皱了皱眉，不由得往身后看了看，有些后悔直接带着人上门来。明天村里只怕又要传出什么李家的笑话来。“你俩，知道什么该说什么不该说吧？”他意有所指地暗示。
content_en: Liu Ye's legs and feet were very fast. As soon as the Zhang family finished breakfast, he had already prepared all the bamboos.Without anyone having to explain, he just started breaking the bamboo with a hatchet.Small ones can be used directly.The middle one is split in half.For larger ones, split into four pieces.He first planted large pillars every three to five meters along the edge of the courtyard, and then began to insert bamboos and surround them as he went.Xu Xidi pulled Sister Ba'er out to help, while Fan Jinhua went to replant the vegetable field.Zhang Guohai sat at the door, looked at it for a few moments, turned around and went into the house, and came out again after a while.In short, he did nothing but watched them work."This bamboo is cutting my hand, just hold it for me and don't move it." Liu Ye didn't let Xu Xidi do anything.You don't need to hold me up, but if you have someone to help you, you can do the job faster.In this way, Xu Xidi and Sister Ba'er were inside the courtyard, and Liu Ye was outside the courtyard. The three of them faced each other and built a new fenced courtyard bit by bit.Other families’ fences are made of finger-sized twigs, but only the Zhang family’s fences are made of bright green bamboo.No one spoke, and Sister Ba'er didn't know how to speak."What's wrong with Yongfu? I always hear him shouting in the house." Liu Ye finally broke the silence."I fell out of bed at night and kept shouting. I don't know whether it's real pain or fake pain." Xu Xidi couldn't tell whether Zhang Yongfu was letting out anger and asking for help, or whether it was real pain.The old couple remained silent, and it was hard for her to say anything.She had no money, and she couldn't carry him half a day to town alone."Did he really fall somewhere?" Liu Ye kept working. If Zhang Yongfu was really injured, someone would really need to send him to the town for a checkup."Shall I take a look at it tomorrow?" Xu Xidi glanced at Fan Jinhua.Fan Jinhua seemed not to have heard anything, not even raising his head or making a sound.After a while, she went out with a handful of vegetables."Liu Ye, I'll go to your house first and help you make lunch."... We worked until noon and only a small section of the yard was repaired.Xu Xidi was about to go into the house to cook lunch when the captain hurried over with two people."Zhang Guohai, come out for a moment." "Liu Ye, don't leave yet." Not knowing what happened, Xu Xidi and Sister Ba'er, Zhang Guohai and Liu Ye were gathered outside the gate of Zhang Family Courtyard."Zhang Guohai, let me ask you, did you let Liu Ye go to Zhao's house last night?" The captain asked directly without asking for words, "Because he cut down your fence and vegetable field, you deliberately took revenge?" When Zhang Guohai heard this, his eyes widened, "I..." He turned to look at Liu Ye, "You went to find Zhao Xiaoyi last night?" Liu Ye shook his head, very innocently, "I didn't go! I have no grudge against him, why should I go to him?" "Captain, what happened to Zhao Xiaoyi? He still owes my family 80 yuan and hasn't paid!" Zhang Guohai is only thinking about the compensation.If something happens to the grandson, won't the money be wasted?"He was sleeping, and his legs were broken in the middle of the night. He was also beaten with a bruise and a swollen face. He said that he saw the tall figure of the other person and insisted that it was you, Liu Ye!" The captain pointed to Liu Ye's nose and said in a affirmative tone."Don't even think about it. If someone beats you up, he will say that the fifty yuan under the pillow was also taken away. This is a crime! Do you understand?" "When the police are here, they will definitely be sentenced to home invasion robbery and jail time!" "Before it makes a big fuss, I will return the money and I will pretend that it was nothing. The fight is a personal grudge, and he was wrong to chop down your yard.First, we can resolve this matter privately and not report it to the police."Captain, what does it have to do with him cutting down Zhang's yard?"Liu Ye said calmly, "Did anyone see me coming to his house?""Don't deny me, if I didn't come yesterday, you would have beaten me on the spot."The captain frowned, his face gloomy.If someone saw him, he would go directly to report it to the police, why would he come here to check on someone?When Zhang Guohai heard this, he was beaten and his leg was broken, and the money was gone, so the designated 80 yuan was gone."Captain, I didn't let Liu Ye hit anyone! If he did, he would have nothing to do with me!" "But no matter what happens to Zhao Xiaoyi, he should pay eighty yuan to my family, but not a penny less. You agreed in front of everyone yesterday. If he refuses to pay, I have to go to your house!" Xu Xidi has not spoken yet, but he is secretly happy in his heart.Well played.Otherwise, he would come to the house every now and then to cut the yard, and how would he live like this?Somehow, she felt that it was Liu Ye who did it.He must have vented his anger on the Zhang family on her behalf.But she couldn't tell, so she got another family involved."Captain, is it possible that it's Aunt Li's family? After all, the incident between Aunt Li and Zhao Ding has made their family almost unable to raise their heads." "Zhao Ding was arrested, so he didn't say it, and Zhao Xiaoyi is such a bastard..." "My father is the only one in our family, but he can't beat Zhao Xiaoyi.Aunt Li's family is different, there are three strong men."Uncle Ye is strong, but he is naive and has never done anything to anyone. He only works for people to get food, so why would he hit Zhao Xiaoyi for no reason?"Liu Ye stood aside and nodded desperately.The feeling of being protected by this little girl's righteous words is quite beautiful."Captain, what do you do?" The two villagers behind the captain already believed it.The main reason is that the Zhang family is too weak and has no influence.Liu Ye is just a stupid bastard, and he will never hit anyone."Go to Zhu Ying's house first." The captain could only say this.If Li Zhuying also denies it, then he can only report it to the police for investigation.The captain comes and goes in a hurry.As soon as the people left, Zhang Guohai's face dropped. "What did you two discuss? If Zhao Xiaoyi was injured, can we still pay for the compensation for repairing the yard?" Xu Xidi denied, "He and his father should be beaten, butThey deserved the beating this time, and it has nothing to do with us.I will not ask Uncle Ye to do such a thing."I have no grievances with the Zhao family," Liu Ye shrugged, as if it was nothing to do with him."Is it really the Li family?" Zhang Guohai also believed it.He entered the house with his hands behind his back.Xu Xidi and Liu Ye looked at each other in tacit understanding.He smiled innocently.She was even more certain that he was the one who hit her.He knew that Zhao Xiaoyi would not pay the eighty yuan, so he simply came to the house to give him a beating to relieve his anger.As for the fifty yuan... "Uncle, if the person who beat Zhao Xiaoyi took the fifty yuan, he wouldn't just leave it at home and wait for the captain to search it, right?" she said secretly.Liu Ye was stunned, "I'm going home for lunch first. I'll come back after eating. I should be able to finish repairing the yard today." After that, he hurried home....The captain came to Li Zhuying's house. When he entered the door, he saw Aunt Li with a bruised nose and swollen face, sitting in the main room chopping pork and vegetables.No one says hello when someone comes in.He frowned and couldn't help but look behind him, regretting that he came directly to the door with someone.Tomorrow, there will be another Li family joke spread in the village."You two know what to say and what not to say, right?" He hinted pointedly.
